title: crawlkit findings
description: Stable wire contract for crawlkit analysis findings, emitted by `crawlkit inspect` (findings array) and `crawlkit crawl` (post-crawl-findings.json), and produced by plugin findings (which deserialize into the same Finding type). The REST API's `GET /api/v1/crawls/{id}/findings` adds storage fields (id, page_id, element) and is documented by its own OpenAPI schema. Pin an exact schema version when consuming in CI; additive changes only within a major version.

severity.description: Lowercase severity. Order: critical > error > warning > info.

category.description: Lowercase category string; `custom:<name>` for plugin-generated categories.

code.description: Stable machine-readable issue code, e.g. META001, HTTP005. Codes persist across releases; see docs/capabilities.toml [counts] for the live total.

url.description: Page the finding was produced for. Empty string is permitted when the finding applies crawl-wide (single-URL context or post-crawl analysis where the page is carried by the wrapper).
